concerns.text: The plan states: “All other functional requirements (FR‑001 – FR‑011) will be satisfied on the separate modality datasets that are publicly available.” FR‑001 explicitly requires **matched diffusion‑MRI and resting‑state EEG from the same participants**. The cited datasets (OpenNeuro fslr64k for dMRI and Neurofusion EEG for EEG) are **unmatched**, and the plan does not provide a verified open‑source matched dataset. Using separate‑modality data therefore violates FR‑001 and makes the core research question (structure‑function coupling) unsolvable with the chosen resources. This constitutes a methodology‑level flaw: the selected datasets are inappropriate for the intended analysis.
